vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: CVE-2026-43002 is PUBLISHED and the vendor advisory identifies Horizon >=25.6.0 <25.7.3. Commit 3e2ff4e063fb46dc2a790670648dc6e1ca9b5a79 writes request.GET['next'] into request.session before authentication; Django then persists a new server-side session for unauthenticated requests, bypassing the existing HorizonMiddleware unauthenticated early return and enabling session-store exhaustion.

atomic_bic.evidence: git log -S post_login_redirect, the one-file BIC diff, and blame/ancestry evidence identify single-parent commit 3e2ff4e063fb46dc2a790670648dc6e1ca9b5a79 as the smallest landed commit that first writes the vulnerable session key.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: Immediate parent 827a566d349020853e0370b6bf90066dd56b6ec2 resolves locally, and a full-tree git grep finds no post_login_redirect; the BIC diff introduces all four references in openstack_auth/views.py.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: The BIC has one parent and changes only openstack_auth/views.py. Gerrit change 950302 has two patch-set revisions of the same change; patch set 2 is the landed BIC and is the second parent of Zuul merge af96b50bd0047312c9362350a8be2851c3ded51f. The merge is not the BIC, and there is no squash aggregate or finer landed member to substitute.

affected_release_membership.evidence: The BIC is not an ancestor of 25.5.0, but is an ancestor of 25.6.0, 25.7.0, 25.7.1, and 25.7.2; those affected tags contain post_login_redirect in openstack_auth/views.py.

fixed_release_membership.evidence: Stable fix 78d0d05c606c570afe080fcbe2814d8d836d20fe is an ancestor of tag 25.7.3 but not 25.7.2, and 25.7.3 no longer contains post_login_redirect. Master fix ac250004a62b909f33b4a06b41123aa0e46244f0 is an ancestor of 26.0.0, which also lacks the vulnerable key.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.evidence: Direct fix ac250004a62b909f33b4a06b41123aa0e46244f0 removes the unauthenticated session write and carries the redirect in a cookie; 78d0d05c606c570afe080fcbe2814d8d836d20fe is its explicit stable/2026.1 cherry-pick and is the fix shipped in 25.7.3.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The BIC commit object alone shows human author and committer dchakalov <dchakalov@godaddy.com>, with only Change-Id and Signed-off-by trailers. Its author, committer, message, and trailers contain no AI generator, AI co-author, bot identity, or other AI marker; the later Zuul merge and fix commits were excluded from attribution.

findings: The primary NOT_AI verdict is supported by an independently replayed vulnerability-first causal chain from the parent-clean tree through the landed BIC to affected and fixed releases.
